race.title: SES Engineering Powering Past The Rehearsal Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
race.verdict: Anthony Honeyball holds a solid hand here with JORDANS CROSS and Crest of Fortune , the former taken to get back on track with the form of his Cheltenham win at the start of the year proving strong. Venetia Williams has a good record in this, so Alcedo is another to consider having won at this meeting 12 months ago. JORDANS CROSS (IRE) CREST OF FORTUNE ALCEDO (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Jordans Cross (4/1), Apple Away (5/1), Il Est Francais (11/2), Laurens Bay (6/1), First Confession (8/1), Crest Of Fortune (8/1), Alcedo (10/1), King Turgeon (10/1), Konfusion (14/1), Intense Approach (14/1)
